Premiums, Expenditures and Caseload Reports

The Premiums, Expenditures and Caseload Reports describe monthly spending and caseload statistics on the Medical Services Premiums budget and occasionally other important information.

Note: These reports contain data about the prior month. The information contained in each report reflects the month specified in the link, not the date of the report. For example, a report with the link August will reference August activity, but the report will be dated September. Should you require a report prior to the current fiscal year, please email HCPF Budget with your request.
